title: High School of Memories
description:
A casual adventure in a high school settingEmbark on a new journey to high school where you learn how to 
build friendships, welcome others, and have good times with the people you care about.Stunning visuals and a wonderful art styleThe cities, the landscapes, the characters... all of it looks so wonderful 
once you see it 
on your screen.Uplifting music and songs for you to enjoyThe graceful music and uplifting songs will bring you a 
relaxing ambience as you play the game. Sing along with the songs and replay the videos as much as you like!100 Gallery Pictures To CollectCollect biographies, pictures, and scenes with all of your favorite characters! 
Learn more about the characters and enjoy the memories you shared in the story!Save often so you can return to your favorite chaptersThere are over 100 Save Slots for you to use. It's a good idea to save at the beginning 
of each chapter and song. That way, you can always come back to your favorite scenes and songs!Steam Achievements for you to collectPlay through the game and get Steam Achievements! 
There's 13 to collect in all!Additional Notes
This game is family friendly and has no adult content.

The game is meant to be played as if you were watching an anime or 
reading a manga. 

As the writers of the story, we wish to bring these heart-warming memories to you 
so that you can enjoy them as well. 

This game will give you the most impact if you read it from start to finish. 

Thank you!
description_short: Class is about to be in session at Kaisouroku High School, where the students welcome you. Start building friendships, welcoming others, and having good times in this anime world, High School of Memories!
